objective: Place the verified trajectory-system bootstrap in a namespaced experiment inside rfreel/T0 without changing T0 main.

granted: create dedicated feature branch in rfreel/T0
write the trajectory system under experiments/trajectory-system
open a draft pull request against main
verify remote files and pull request state

environment.identity: GitHub account rfreel through connected GitHub app

material_rivals.hypothesis: A compact repository scaffold is sufficient to reconstruct and resume work.
material_rivals.action_difference: Run one local trial before adding automation.

material_rivals.hypothesis: The scaffold creates more coordination cost than it removes.
material_rivals.action_difference: Abandon or shrink fields after trial evidence.

next_decision.observation: Does the dedicated GitHub branch contain the complete namespaced system and expose it through a draft PR while main remains unchanged?
next_decision.collection_method: compare main to branch, enumerate PR files, fetch control files, and inspect commit status

selected_action.action: publish the bootstrap under experiments/trajectory-system on a dedicated branch and open a draft PR
selected_action.reversibility: close the draft PR and delete the feature branch
selected_action.expected_effect: durable, inspectable GitHub home with T0 root behavior unchanged
selected_action.stopping_boundary: stop after remote verification; do not merge

verification.failure_mechanism: wrong repository, wrong path, missing files, altered T0 main, or non-draft publication
verification.verifier: GitHub branch comparison, PR file enumeration, fetched control files, and commit status
verification.acceptance_condition: all local files appear under the namespace, control content matches, PR is draft, and main remains at the observed base commit

recovery.rollback: close draft PR and delete agent/trajectory-system-bootstrap
